color.note: Canonical --ls-* names, declared once in shared/ui/tokens.css for both surfaces. Values the code writes as color-mix() are flattened here and marked as such.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Popup page background behind cards. Was --current-bg-primary.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, sheets, the rating panel. Was --current-bg-surface / --ls-surface.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Hover fill for quiet buttons and rows, empty-state wells, kbd chips, skeletons. Was --current-bg-secondary / --ls-raised.

tokens.name: raised-2
tokens.usage: Pressed or nested fill one step above raised. Was --current-bg-tertiary.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for list rows (problem rows, card rows). Flattened from color-mix(raised 70%, transparent).

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface and raised. Was --current-text-primary / --ls-fg.

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, intervals, quiet button labels. On surface and raised. Was --current-text-secondary / --ls-fg-2.

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: metadata, weekday labels, icon buttons at rest. At least 4.5:1 on canvas, surface and raised in both themes (4.6:1 on light raised).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline card borders and dividers. Was --current-border / --ls-line.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders on outline buttons, menus and the save sheet's top edge. Was --current-border-strong.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The LeetSRS green: primary fills, accent text, links, active state. 5.4:1 on white. Replaces both --current-accent and --current-brand (identical values).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill for chips, counts and card-variant save buttons; brand text on it holds 4.8:1. Was --current-accent-soft.

tokens.name: brand-soft-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for brand-soft buttons. Flattened from color-mix(brand 18%, canvas).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill. Dark text in dark mode because the fill lightens. Was --current-on-accent.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline on every interactive control, offset 2px (or -2px inside lists). Was --ls-focus.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Filled destructive buttons (confirm delete); put on-danger text on it. Was --current-danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a danger fill (confirm delete). Dark text in dark mode because the fill lightens: 4.8:1 light, 5.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Red text and icons on surface, canvas and danger-soft. Was --danger-text.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error notice background. Flattened from color-mix(danger 9%/14%, surface).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning icons, the calendar's overdue dot. Not for light-mode body text; use warning-text.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning text on surface (5.2:1 light).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning notice background. Flattened from color-mix(warning 12%, surface).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational icons and dots only (3.9:1 on white clears the 3:1 bar for graphics). Never body text.

tokens.name: difficulty-easy
tokens.usage: Easy difficulty label and dot, on surface.

tokens.name: difficulty-medium
tokens.usage: Medium difficulty label and dot, on surface.

tokens.name: difficulty-hard
tokens.usage: Hard difficulty label and dot, on surface.

tokens.name: skipped
tokens.usage: Skipped-problem marks in roadmap progress. At least 3:1 on surface and raised in both themes; pair with a label in legends.

tokens.name: switch-off
tokens.usage: Settings switch track when off.

tokens.name: switch-thumb
tokens.usage: Settings switch thumb in both states.

tokens.name: rating-again
tokens.usage: Again rating dot and row tint.

tokens.name: rating-hard
tokens.usage: Hard rating dot and row tint.

tokens.name: rating-good
tokens.usage: Good rating dot and row tint.

tokens.name: rating-easy
tokens.usage: Easy rating dot and row tint.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Calendar day with light review load. Flattened from color-mix(brand 11%/14%).

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Calendar day, moderate load. Flattened from color-mix(brand 24%/28%).

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Calendar day, heavy load. Flattened from color-mix(brand 44%/48%).

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Calendar day, heaviest load; its number is on-brand (4.6:1 light, 5.7:1 dark). Flattened from color-mix(brand 92%/80%).

tokens.name: host-fill
tokens.usage: On LeetCode.com only: the in-page LeetSRS button's fill, matched to LeetCode's own toolbar buttons.

tokens.name: host-fill-hover
tokens.usage: On LeetCode.com only: hover fill for the in-page button.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind the bottom sheet and dialogs.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One headline per view state, e.g. the Home fresh-start title.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers in roadmap and review summaries; use tabular numerals.

styles.name: view-title
styles.usage: The title in each view's header, set in mono.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Row titles, card body, rating rows. Medium (500) for a row title.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: The workhorse: buttons, menu items, notices, metadata. Tailwind text-xs.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Counts in badges, calendar weekdays, kbd hints.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Title of the in-page rating panel.

styles.name: panel-body
styles.usage: Rating rows in the in-page panel (line-height 1.35).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The LeetSRS wordmark in the panel header. The bundled font is a subset for this word only.

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px step (content pins --spacing: 4px so the host page's root size can't change it).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Menu padding, icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Button icon gap, rating list inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default gap, quiet button padding.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Notice and outline-button horizontal padding, rating row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card-variant button padding, banner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, view gutters.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact outline/ghost buttons, toolbar chips (h-7).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Text and icon buttons, menu items (h-8).

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, compact rating rows.

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Rating rows in the popup sheet.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, kbd chips, count pills (Tailwind rounded / rounded-sm).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, menu items, calendar days.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, notices, rating rows, primary buttons, problem rows.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, the rating panel, empty-state wells.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet top corners, dialog icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Dots, switch, today marker.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card and menu popover.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating panels over LeetCode.com (the rating panel, toasts). Was --ls-shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The popup's bottom sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: The settings switch thumb.
